job_function: credit derivatives control - determinations committee outcome application
control_point: After a Credit Derivatives Determinations Committee resolution, affected credit-derivative positions are re-papered, cash-settled or adjusted in accordance with the applicable Credit Derivatives Definitions, governed by credit trading with product control confirmation of the resulting position or settlement amount.

citations.clause: Article III and Article XII (Credit Events, Succession Events and related settlement provisions)
Rules governing DC resolutions, public questions and binding effect on market participants

consequence_anchor.public_source: ISDA 2014 Credit Derivatives Definitions auction settlement and succession-event adjustment mechanics; market-published CDS settlement amounts and reference-entity succession splits
consequence_anchor.magnitude_band: wrong auction settlement amount or erroneous succession split applied to CDS position; material mark-to-market and settlement-amount exposure, scaled by net-position notional

commonality_rationale: Every sell-side institution active in credit derivatives holds CDS positions governed by ISDA Definitions and subject to DC resolutions; the auction and succession mechanics are standardized across the market and the operational control is a known recurring process.
